comments.author: PRoFeSSoR_GSc
comments.body_html: Scope reticles size in the vanilla game was optimized with ADS FOV changing in mind. This mod removes standart ADS FOV change (by default), ergo scopes themselves and reticles inside them appear much smaller on the screen. You can fix that only by manually restoring ADS FOV change. Go to F12 menu and change ADS FOV Multi for all magnifications (for it to be consistent across all powered scopes) to around 0.6 or 0.7. Reticles will return to “normal”, variable zoom will still work fine.
